notes.title: Regarding the Chinese language version of ISLAND
notes.notes:
This is an update regarding the status of the Chinese language version of ISLAND.
Currently, the Chinese translation of the game is completed, and the Chinese language version is in the debugging phase. In order to ensure we deliver the highest quality product possible, the release of the Chinese version will be delayed to beyond the release of the English and Japanese versions. The Chinese language version will be released as a game update on Steam. When work has been completed, we will announce the expected release window for the update. We apologize for the inconvenience, and appreciate your continued support.
